title: Chapter 243 Post-War Trivia Ii
content:
Chapter 243 Post-War Trivia Ii

In fact, Zhong Yu didn't have the slightest intention to shirk the award of meritorious officers and men. Isn't it just some land? There are many royal kingdoms in him.

Zhong Yu's real goal is not these mundane territories, but the luck of this world, and the establishment of a high heaven, which is transcendent from everything in the world and is eternal.

So this little piece of land is less than 1% of a country, so he doesn't have any heartache at all, just give it away, will it cause any hindrance to Yuguo?

No, on the contrary, it will bring great benefits to Yuguo.

Not to mention anything else, just say that after the opening of this reward, the morale of the entire coalition army will be greatly boosted, and the will to fight against Qin will be extremely high.

After all, what the Qin army conferred was only the land of some countries, which still belonged to Qin in essence, and the title could be deprived at any time.

Which one can compare to Zhong Yu directly sealing a country? Let you be the king, and it is impossible to deprive you of the title, which is tantamount to reaching the sky in one step.

With this kind of treatment where the difference can be seen through comparison, it is naturally predictable that both sides can reflect my fighting will and determination to fight to the death.

So since the decision on awarding the reward has not changed, and it is planned to be carried out as scheduled, then what is it that makes the commander of the coalition forces, the aloof Zhong Yu, feel worried!

In fact, in the final analysis, it was because of this reward.

Although the rewards greatly boosted the morale of the army, they made them dare to fight and fight with their lives to fight for prosperity.

But after the hard work, those who survived got the wealth, honor, and power they wanted, and their fighting will was not even as good as before there was no reward order.

As I said before, the barefoot is not afraid of the shoe, but the shoe is afraid of the barefoot. With the award, the soldier will change from the barefoot to the shoe, and even more honor than the shoe.

So those who wear shoes, for such a dangerous job as fighting? How could it not start to resist and fear.

The current coalition army is facing such an embarrassing situation. Those generals and soldiers who have received rewards are beginning to demand to return to their fiefs and live the life of their fantasy grand masters and the supreme monarchy.

So what should the high-level coalition forces do with their request? how to think?

Let them go. As soon as they left, a large number of elites left, which greatly depleted the strength of the coalition army, and made the disparity in strength between the Qin army and the Qin army even worse.

And these soldiers are not just encountered, but also Yan Guo, South Korea, they are the last old elites, they are gone, what will the monarchs of the two countries do? They also count on these elites to defend their authority and maintain their most basic rule.

But if they don't do it and force them to finish the battle, how can these soldiers be willing? An inadvertent mistake may cause a mutiny among the soldiers, further weaken the strength of the coalition forces, and severely damage the prestige of the coalition forces, as well as the reputation of Yuguo in the world.

So now faced with such a difficult problem, Zhong Yu and the kings of the two countries repeatedly discussed in charge. On this issue of rewards, after discussing for three full days, they finally came up with an answer acceptable to both parties.

Although Zhong Yu made the promise of rewards and was really willing to implement them, but after the implementation, in fact, each soldier could not get much.

After all, he only gave so many rewards, and he also limited the target of reaching the reward. Among the more than 30,000 survivors, there were actually only two to three thousand soldiers who could really reach such a target.

Such a small number of people is nothing more than a small change to the entire coalition army. They left, so let's go, there is no big hindrance.

In fact, if you really count, there are not even two or three thousand people, and there are only a few real people.

After all, Zhong Yu's most basic requirement is to seal the country, and there are only five or six people who can meet this requirement, even if many generals in the coalition army try their best.

These five or six people have met the basic requirements, and they can barely divide the fiefdom of a county as their basic national territory. They asked to take office, Zhong Yu really had no reason to refuse.

Now they are the status of the king of a country after all, even if the land of the king is too small, only one county, but it is still the king, and there is still due respect.

It is inhuman and difficult for the world to ask the king of a country to wear armor and charge on the battlefield with a body of a thousand pieces of gold.

So Zhong Yu readily agreed to their request to leave.

However, if they want to return to the country with their subordinates as the foundation of their rule and the power to maintain their country's existence, it is difficult to accept.

Isn't this the corner of the Allied Army? Those soldiers were all elites who had been trained hard by the coalition forces and had barely grown up after countless killings.

It can be said that these soldiers are able to survive now because they have eliminated an unknown number of their companions before they can come to the present. They have become the real elite and the foundation for maintaining the rule of all countries. How can these people pry away as soon as they say it? ?

Don't say that Zhong Yu didn't agree, just say that the king of these soldiers didn't agree.

What these few people want to take away is not so many hundreds or dozens of people, but tens of thousands of them. Once they leave, the coalition forces can basically be said to be abolished.

So in the end, after countless discussions and coordination, the two parties reached this resolution.

First, these monarchs demanded to take office immediately, no problem, let them go or stay.

Second, they asked to return to the country with a certain number of personal guards as a force to defend their authority and maintain the existence of the country. This is also possible. However, the number needs to be limited. Only those soldiers who have made outstanding achievements and have truly reached a certain target can return with them.

Third, after these national troops return to the fief, he can have half a year to sort out domestic politics, but after half a year, they must organize a group of troops and rush to the battlefield again to support the coalition's crusade.

The general content is these. After such a few restrictions, the number of people these monarchs can take away is very, very small, just over two thousand.

After these elites who were taken away returned to the fiefdoms of those monarchs, it was said that some soldiers with more noble status and more meritorious service would become the village heads of a small village with dozens of people, and these villages would become the fiefdoms of these soldiers.

And some soldiers with lower status and less military achievements will also become nobles of that country, that is, soldiers, but they have no fiefdoms, only reputation.
